title: Paper Trail
tagline: Roam freely, draw loops, claim the map, cut your rivals' trails. Online rooms with bots.

controls.keyboard: Mouse to steer, or A / D and arrows to turn

description: A territory battle in the style of paper.io / territorygames.io for up to 6 players, with bots filling empty seats. Steer freely (mouse, keyboard or touch) around a big map while the camera follows you. Leave your land to draw a trail, swing back to claim everything you enclosed, and touch a rival's trail to knock them out. Most land when the 2.5 minutes run out wins.
